department: Molecular & Cellular Biology Graduate Program (UW and Fred Hutch)

deadline.value: International applicants must apply by November 2, 2026 (11:59 pm PT); the domestic deadline is December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: International Application deadline: 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time, Monday, November 2, 2026. | Domestic Application deadline: 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time, Tuesday, December 1, 2026.

gre_general.quote: Please note that the MCB Program does not require GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 overall (92 old scale) and speaking 5 (26 old scale); Duolingo is not accepted.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL-iBT/TOEFL iBT Home Edition: 4.5 overall (or 92 for tests taken before Jan 21, 2026) AND 5 on the speaking section (or 26 for tests taken before Jan 21, 2026).

ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7 overall and 7 on the speaking section.

english_waiver.value: Only a bachelor's from the US or a listed English-speaking country (India is not listed) exempts you; a master's does not count, so Indian applicants need TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: hold a bachelor’s degree from an institution in Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Australia, the Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Canada, Dominica, Ghana, Grenada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Liberia, Montserrat, New Zealand, Nigeria, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Singapore, South Africa, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United Kingdom, or the Virgin Islands, where English is the medium of instruction. | Important: A master’s degree does not satisfy this requirement.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go through the Graduate School and are only for US citizens in financial need (plus McNair/PPIA); MCB has no program waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are processed through the UW Graduate School and are only available for US citizens who qualify for financial need. | MCB does not offer any program-based waivers or program-based application fee assistance.

supervisor.value: You list faculty you would like to meet at interview, but you do not need to contact anyone before applying.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to contact MCB faculty before submitting your application.

funding.value: All students get a 12-month salary ($49,392 from July 2026), tuition waiver and benefits; funding is guaranteed for the whole PhD with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students with satisfactory academic progress are guaranteed funding for the duration of study. | 12-month competitive salary (Effective July 1, 2026: $49,392 or $4,116/month)

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in biology, physical/natural sciences or maths; PhD-only program.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have received a baccalaureate degree or higher (non-master’s) at the time of matriculation; degrees emphasizing biology, physical or natural sciences, and mathematics are preferred.

notes: International applicants are expected to have at least one year of experience in a U.S.-based lab (or explain equivalent experience). Invited applicants interview in person in January-February.
